src/domains/common-nip19.ts.name: Nostr id encoder
src/domains/common-nip19.ts.description: Self-contained encoder and decoder for public bech32 Nostr ids (npub, note, nprofile, nevent, naddr, nrelay); rejects private keys.

src/domains/common.ts.name: Common Nostr actions mock
src/domains/common.ts.description: Encodes and decodes Nostr ids, reads profiles and follows, and follows, unfollows, reacts and reports through the shared store.

src/domains/count.ts.name: Event count mock
src/domains/count.ts.description: Answers count queries over the shared event store after checking each filter, with a control to queue a failure for the next query.

src/domains/dm.ts.name: Direct messages mock
src/domains/dm.ts.description: Keeps conversations and messages in memory, answers status, list, send and subscribe, and can simulate an incoming message.

src/domains/identity.ts.name: Signed-in user mock
src/domains/identity.ts.description: Answers questions about the signed-in user: public key, relays, profile, follows, lists, zaps, mutes, blocks and badges, with sign-in controls.

src/domains/keys.ts.name: Keyboard shortcuts mock
src/domains/keys.ts.description: Records forwarded keystrokes and napplet-registered actions, refuses reserved key combos, and pushes binding and action messages.

src/domains/lists.ts.name: Nostr lists mock
src/domains/lists.ts.description: Reports supported mute, pin, bookmark, interest, follow-set and relay lists and adds or removes items for the signed-in user.

src/domains/nostr-store.ts.name: Shared Nostr event store
src/domains/nostr-store.ts.description: One in-memory event store the social mocks share, seeded with sample events, list fixtures and a muted spam account; also holds small helpers other mocks reuse.

src/domains/outbox.ts.name: Outbox routing mock
src/domains/outbox.ts.description: Plans which relays to use per author from relay-list events, and answers outbox get, query, subscribe, publish and relay resolution.

src/domains/pow.ts.name: Proof-of-work mock
src/domains/pow.ts.description: Simulates mining jobs step by step, queueing, pausing, resuming and cancelling them, and pushes progress until an id meeting the target is found.

src/domains/relay.ts.name: Relay mock
src/domains/relay.ts.description: Answers relay subscribe, close, publish, encrypted publish and query from the shared event store, pushing matching events to live subscriptions.

src/domains/value.ts.name: Payments mock
src/domains/value.ts.description: Quotes and sends pretend payments that start pending and settle later on a timer or by control, then pushes the status change.
